en: Points of Controversy The Chapter on the Path of Certainty The Eighth Section
The Discourse on the Six Destinations. Are there six destinations?
Yes, they are.
But has it not been stated by the Blessed One that there are five destinies—
“hell, the animal realm, the sphere of hungry ghosts, human beings, and devas”?—
Yes, it has.
If five destinies were indeed spoken of by the Blessed One—
namely, hell, the animal realm, the sphere of hungry ghosts, humans, and devas—
then surely it should not be said: [that there are only four].
“Six destinies.
Are there six destinies? Yes.

Is it not the case that the Kālakañjika asuras have the same appearance, the same enjoyments, the same food, and the same lifespan as the petas, and that they enter into marriage alliances with the petas?
Yes, it is so.

If the Kālakañjika asuras have the same appearance, the same enjoyments, the same food, and the same lifespan as the petas, and enter into marriage alliances with them, then indeed, it should not be said [that there is no difference between them].
“Six destinies.
Are there six destinies? Yes.

Is it not the case that the assembly of the Vepacitti gods, having the same appearance, the same enjoyments, the same food, and the same lifespan as the gods, enter into marriage alliances with the gods?
Yes, it is so.

If the assembly of the Vepacitti gods, having the same appearance, the same enjoyments, the same food, and the same lifespan as the gods, enter into marriage alliances with the gods, then indeed, sir, you should not say: [that they are not equal].
“Six destinies.
Are there six destinies? Yes.
Is it not the case that the assembly of Vepacitti were former gods?
Yes, they were.
If the assembly of Vepacitti were former gods, then indeed you should not say—
“Six destinies.
Should it not be said that there are six destinies?
“Yes.
“But is there not a host of asuras?
“Yes.”
If there is a host of asuras, then indeed, O friend,
it must be said that there are "six destinies. The Discussion on the Six Destinies is concluded.
